title: Terminal Relay run summary
description: Shape of results/<team_slug>/<UTC_timestamp>/summary.json written when a game ends. This is the payload nested under POST /api/v1/runs as `summary`.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when summary.json was written

team.description: Team display name. Treat as unique event-wide.

started_at.description: Local wall-clock start time from the game PC

finished_at.description: Local wall-clock finish time from the game PC

reason.description: Why the run ended (time up, all categories complete, etc.)

time_used_seconds.description: Game-clock used in seconds (tie-break: lower wins)

game_limit_seconds.description: Allotted game time in seconds (often 1500; do not hardcode)

game_remaining.description: Seconds left on the game clock at finish

leg_remaining.description: Seconds left on the current leg at finish

counted_answers.description: Last answer per question (redos replace earlier). May contain answer text — store on Pi, do not expose publicly.

attempts.description: Every answer/skip in order. May contain answer keys — store on Pi, do not expose publicly.
